descriptionHtml: Altium Designer is a PCB and electronic design automation software package for printed circuit boards. As a student, your passion for designing electronics is limited only by the resources that you have at your disposal. The IEEE Student Branch of the University of Peradeniya believes that the future of electronics lies in the hands of students just like you. So that's why we're committed to helping you along every step of your journey. The student license of Altium Designer is now available for the students of the University of Peradeniya.
